about: Every answer of the covered route files of coax/web/api/ (docs/protocol/api-routes-v1alpha1.md): "routes" names each answer (the route function that gives it, its C file, the method, the path with * for one name and ** for the rest, the status, the kind of body and the message that names its members; a path of /** is a refusal any route of that function may give), and "goldens" holds real answers of each, byte for byte, from a run of the API suite on a throwaway database (coax/web/api/test.sh with API_CAPTURE; keys, tickets and ids in them are that run's and open nothing). The rows whose fn is rm_rooms are a --dev room server's answers to the rooms list. Checked by coax/web/api/routes-goldens.coax, which the suite also runs on every answer of each run, and (the rooms list) by coax/web/room/rooms-list-profile.coax.
